description: Convert any date and time between world time zones using real IANA zones like Asia/Karachi and America/New_York. Also shows the live current time in six major zones.

faqs.a: The conversion reads your input as wall-clock time in the source zone, converts to UTC, then formats it in the target zone. DST and offsets are handled automatically.
faqs.q: How does the time zone conversion work?

faqs.a: Yes. The zones list includes the offsets and daylight-saving rules built into the browser via Intl, so DST transitions are handled.
faqs.q: Does it handle daylight saving time?

faqs.a: The live clocks update every second from your device clock, converted into each zone.
faqs.q: How do the live world clocks work?

howto: Pick the source time zone and the target time zone.
Scroll down for live clocks in six major time zones.
title: Time Zone Converter
